title: General MIDI
description: Plays the notes it receives with a General MIDI program (bank and program number) from a SoundFont 2 file of the project. Compact notes support per-note pan, fine pitch, release, cutoff and slide without a second attack. It needs a SoundFont file and gives audio.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.doc: MIDI channel from 0 to 15; -1 follows the input note channel.

parameters.name: limiter
parameters.doc: Integer soft limiter at the PCM output; off keeps hard clipping.

parameters.name: level
parameters.doc: auto brings the loudest note of the block to -6 dBFS before the gain, because SoundFont presets differ by tens of decibels (an acoustic piano can be 40 dB below a bass); the gain then trims from there. raw keeps the preset level as it is.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: A SoundFont 2 (.sf2) file (parameter file; the default is the MuseScore General pack).
